summary: Restoring with an external database force drops and overwrites it; when restoring to the same instance name set controller.force_drop_db: true in the AnsibleAutomationPlatformRestore.
questions: How do I restore AAP with an external database?
Restore fails because the database already exists

answer_card.title: Restore with an external database
answer_card.answer_md:
Restoring **drops** the existing external database. For the same instance name:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatformRestore
metadata:
  name: aaprestore
spec:
  deployment_name: aap
  backup_name: aapbackup
  controller:
    force_drop_db: true
```
